purpose: Financial mechanics and unweighted scenario sensitivity, not more Monte Carlo paths or forecast-model approval
anchor_source: Existing precision-v1 model and fixed streams; replays only, no new random market draws selected after results
calendar: Projected regular XNYS sessions, Jan 2027 onward; monthly total logs and source variance retained while calendar session counts replace synthetic 21-session months
shock_location: First session on or after 2028-06-15; daily shocks are specified underlying close-to-close returns, not observed events
regime_location: Jan 2028 onward; truncate disclosed duration at each requested horizon
distribution_assumption: Quarterly ordinary cash distribution of 0.5% of previous ex-price, with equal ex-price reduction and payment five sessions later; no claim about any actual ETF distribution
probabilities: UNSPECIFIED: no mixture weights, event frequencies, probability of ruin, outperformance probabilities, model-selection scores or confidence intervals inferred from these cases
uncertainty: Keep prior numerical intervals separate from historical-regime, financing, structural, scenario and future-policy uncertainty; scenario ranges are not posterior coverage
preserve: Original 26+25 historical forecasts, Dec2026 future commitments, original failures, reconstruction thresholds and all prior reports stay immutable
backup: No transfer without approved private destination. Verify member hashes, safe restore into a fresh private directory, permissions and source/forecast identities before claiming recovery; local drill is not off-host verification
